content.title: What stores are open on Easter 2025? Holiday hours for Walmart, Best Buy, Target, Costco, more
content.text: Easter Day/Store Hours Is Walmart open on Easter Day? Is Costco open today? Are Best Buy locations closed for Easter? Are Target stores closed for Easter? Let’s take a look and find out. Easter Day 2025 is upon us and whether you’re staying at home with family hunting for Easter eggs, taking the day off for yourself, or readying celebrations for this afternoon, this evening, or even tomorrow, Easter Sunday is one of those holidays where you’ll want to do a quick search online before you head out and about. If you need to hit up the shops at all today for whatever reason, browsing through the list of store closures below will be a good idea. It, as per usual, is always a good idea to also check with your nearest location for specifics – store hours and closures can vary by location, like those within malls and so forth – we have tracked down some details for you below on which major retailers are open and closed for Easter Day 2025. What stores are open and closed on Easter? We have once again done our best to track down some official detail from a series of the major national retailers to help the cause. This is not a particularly localized or overly extensive list, but rather one focused on the major nation retailer chains, including Walmart, Target, Best Buy, Costco, and so on. This post will will however give you a good idea of what is open and closed today at a quick glance. Again, just make sure you call ahead of time if you can, especially if the store you’re after rests within a mall or something along those lines. Is Walmart open on New Year’s Day 2025? Yes, Walmart will be open for Easter this year as just about all locations are scheduled to be operating regular hours today. Is Target open today? No, Target is not open for Easter. Target is one of a few major retailers that will be doors closed up for Easter Sunday this year. Is Best Buy open today on Easter? No, Best Buy stores are closed for Easter this year, much like Target. Is Costco open on Easter Day 2025? No, Costco brick and mortar warehouse locations will be closed on Easter this year. Is Sam’s Club open today? Nope, Sam’s Club is closed for Easter. As mentioned above both of the major warehouse retailers are closed today Is CVS open today? CVS is open this year for Easter, but it appears that, much like its usual holiday situation some of the locations will only be open during select hours. This is definitely one of the stores you’ll want to call ahead for hours before heading over. Is RiteAid open on Easter? Yes, RiteAid is open this year, but its pharmacy counters will not be. Is Walgreens open on Easter Day 2025? Yes, Walgreens is open today and that includes both its standard retail and pharmacy counters. Is Home Depot open today? Home Depot will be have its doors open from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. today at most locations. Is Staples open today Easter 2025? Staples locations are option today, but only select stores and only from noon to 5 p.m. – you’ll want to call ahead to check your local shop. And here are some additional retailers that are closed and open for Easter day 2025 along with store hour information: Lowe’s Closed Kohl’s Closed Macy’s Closed JCPenney Closed Office Depot Closed OfficeMax Closed Big Lots Open – Regular store hours BJ’s Wholesale Open – Regular store hours PetSmart Open – 11 a.m. to 6 p.m Petco Open – Regular store hours Old Navy Open – Only select locations IKEA Open – 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. Dollar General Open – Regular store hours Dollar Tree Open – Regular store hours Ace Hardware – Check your local shop for specific store hours REI Open – Noon to 6 p.m. Bass Pro Shop Open – 10 a.m. to 7 p.m. Cabela’s Open – 10 a.m. to 7 p.m. FTC: We use income earning auto affiliate links.
